source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: With **HERETIC ASTARTES** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), you can take **KHORNE BERZERKERS**, **RUBRIC MARINES**, **PLAGUE MARINES** and **NOISE MARINES** as allies. Give them **HERETIC ASTARTES** in place of their original Faction keywords. The swaps remove **WORLD EATERS** from KHORNE BERZERKERS, **THOUSAND SONS** from RUBRIC MARINES, **DEATH GUARD** from **PLAGUE MARINES** and **EMPEROR’S CHILDREN** from **NOISE MARINES**. Their combined allowance by [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size) is 250 points at **Incursion**, 500 at **Strike Force** and 750 at **Onslaught**.
